newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's FGV corrects up Dec 21-Jan 20 IGP-M index.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's FGV corrects up Dec 21-Jan 20 IGP-M index.

text.p: The Getulio Vargas Foundation (FGV) said on Friday Brazil's IGP-M inflation index between Dec 21 and Jan 20 was 1.77 percent and not 1.74 percent as released Thursday.

It said in a statement the consumer price index (IPC), which accounts for 30 percent of the IGP-M index, rose 1.86 percent, instead of 1.79 percent. FGV confirmed the figures for the wholesale price index (IPA), which increased 1.93 percent, and the national index of construction costs (INCC), which gained 0.68 percent.
The IGP-M index measures inflation over ten-day intervals.
